programme.title: E4 - The Karst Caves
programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.title: E1 - Spring
programme.desc: It’s spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.title: E3 - One Very Lost Sea Turtle
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: E1 - The Rescuers
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble—both on land and in the water.

programme.title: E4 - Platypus Predicament
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: The competition continues with competitors pushing their bodies to the limit by battling opponents in unforgiving head-to-head challenges, designed by Dwayne Johnson. programme.title: E4 - The Titan Games Trials 4
programme.desc: The competition continues with competitors pushing their bodies to the limit by battling opponents in unforgiving head-to-head challenges, designed by Dwayne Johnson. Winners will advance to the ultimate challenge of Mt. Olympus, the consummate athletic test of speed, strength, agility and endurance. The male and female competitors who conquer Mt. Olympus will become a Titan, and in the end, the Titans return to battle each other. One woman and one man will be crowned Titan Champions. Dwayne Johnson serves as host and Executive Producer, Liam McHugh and Alex Mendez commentate from the skybox and Cari Champion reports from inside the arena.

programme.title: Entre Les Bras, La Cuisine En Heritage

programme.title: E23
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭、內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義。

programme.title: E40 - 把表白玩明白了！

programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.title: No Other Choice
programme.desc: You Man-su, a specialist in paper manufacturing with 25 years of experience, is so satisfied with life that he can truthfully tell himself, “I've got it all.” While happily passing his days with his wife Miri, their two children and two dogs, Man-su is suddenly informed by his company that he has been fired. “We're sorry. We have no other choice.” Feeling shocked as if his head had been cut off by an ax, Man-su vows to find himself a new job within the next three months for the sake of his family. Despite his firm resolve to turn his life around, Man-su spends over a year drifting from one job interview after another, and working at a retail store. He eventually finds himself in danger of losing the very house that he struggled so hard to buy. Desperate, he visits Moon Paper out of the blue and tries to hand over his CV, but he just ends up getting humiliated by line manager Choi Sun-chul. programme.title: Let’s Go Karaoke!
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Lung and his daughter Ying are each other's only dependence. Despite the huge debt left by his ex-wife, Lung believes in good karma for good people, until he loses his beloved daughter in a kidnap while travelling in Thailand. Lung abandons all his faith. He marries a Thai Chinese, Lan, and starts a new life in Thailand. However, he never leaves the past behind. All these years he has been gathering information of the kidnap gang, and vows to take justice into his own hands at any cost...

programme.title: Director’s Premiere -Nick Cheuk
programme.desc: New director Nick Cheuk who won four awards with his debut feature ‘Time Still Turns The Pages', advanced from a screenwriter to a director and have accomplished his movie dream with passion. However, it was not an easy job working three roles at a time especially it was his first time directing. How did he overcome all kinds of challenges during the process? In this interview, Nick will share his unforgettable moments during filming and also talk about his movie beliefs.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: Someone, Someday[Live]
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.
